seo.description: Visit Bab el-Kasbah in Taroudant: the most ornate fortified gate of the ramparts, photo tips and practical advice.
seo.og_description: The signature gate of Taroudant’s walls — ochre towers and a natural stop on any ramparts walk.

name: Bab el-Kasbah
hero_subtitle: The most ornate monumental gate in Taroudant’s 7.5 km of ramparts.

overview.title: The signature gate of the walls
overview.p1: Bab el-Kasbah is the most photogenic and ornate of Taroudant’s fortified gates, on the kasbah side of the medina.
overview.p2: Ochre adobe towers catch the sun dramatically in late afternoon.
overview.p3: Admire it from outside, pass into the kasbah quarter, or continue along the ramparts circuit.

1.title: Getting there
1.desc: On foot from the medina or by petit taxi. Agree fares in advance if the meter is not used.

2.title: Timing
2.desc: Prefer morning or late afternoon in warm months.

3.title: Respect
3.desc: Ask before photographing people; keep valuables secure.

q1.question: Is Bab el-Kasbah free to visit?
q1.answer: In most cases public areas are free. Confirm any ticketed interiors on site.

q2.question: How long should I spend?
q2.answer: Thirty minutes to two hours depending on the site and your pace.

q3.question: What is the best time to go?
q3.answer: Morning or late afternoon for cooler temperatures and better light.

q4.question: How do I get there from the medina?
q4.answer: On foot if central, or by petit taxi. Ask for the place name as a landmark.

q5.question: Can I take photos?
q5.answer: Usually yes outdoors. Ask before photographing people or restricted interiors.
